definition.trend: change from fourth prior weekly release to latest release with source date strictly before signal day
definition.guard: flag invalid if reported custody share count changes over 5% in window
definition.concentration: big1000 +0.5 ppt or more AND retail10 -0.25ppt or less
definition.distribution: big1000 -0.5ppt or less AND retail10 +0.25ppt or more
definition.note: Thresholds are hypotheses, not optimized or confirmed trading signals
